install.note: Official scripts prefer Bun when available, otherwise a standalone binary. The Bun path requires Bun >= 1.3.14; a standalone binary needs neither Node nor Bun. Use --binary / -Binary to explicitly select the binary. Alpine / musl requires libstdc++ and libgcc. The binary is omp, distinct from pi.

install_flow.summary: Official installer or Bun / Homebrew → refresh PATH → verify omp.
agent_steps: Detect OS and architecture. Use the matching official installer; do not impose Pi's Node requirement on OMP.

To force standalone installation, use `curl -fsSL https://omp.sh/install | sh -s -- --binary` or `& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://omp.sh/install.ps1))) -Binary`. If using Bun, verify `bun --version` meets the current package engine requirement first.

If omp.sh rejects automated downloads or is unreachable, the same official source scripts are at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/main/scripts/install.sh and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/main/scripts/install.ps1. Keep the same arguments. Both standalone paths download from the official GitHub Releases.

Refresh PATH and run `omp --version`. Windows standalone installs to %LOCALAPPDATA%\omp\omp.exe; Unix standalone installs to ~/.local/bin/omp. PI_INSTALL_DIR can override those directories; Bun uses its global bin directory.

Start `omp` in the user's terminal for any first-run setup or legacy settings migration. Do not run an interactive TUI through shell_exec. EchoBird manages the default OMP configuration separately from Pi, using models.yml / models.yaml and config.yml / config.yaml under ~/.omp/agent.
Preserve the user's other providers, model roles, sessions and credentials. Do not write Pi's defaultProvider/defaultModel JSON schema into OMP.
tell_user: Verified OMP version and actual installation path
Any unfinished first-run setup or shell PATH refresh

network_requirements.note: Diagnose the failing download host. Use the user's configured proxy or selected package mirror; do not assume Bun or Homebrew bypasses GitHub for every dependency.

identity_guard.description: Oh My Pi is can1357/oh-my-pi, a fork of Pi. Its package is @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent, executable omp, and default config root ~/.omp/agent. Do not install @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent or modify ~/.pi/agent when asked for OMP.
